content_sections.heading: ICAR-IARI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ICAR-IARI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate degree in Agriculture and allied subjects, or a Diploma in relevant Agricultural Sciences (As per ICAR memorandum F. No. Agri. Edn. 1-06/2020-A&P Dated 04.12.2020) Age limit: Maximum 45 years; minimum 21 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, Women 5 years, OBC 3 years Other conditions: Candidates with a near or distant relative employed in ICAR/IARI must declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing Desirable: Bachelor's degree in Agriculture and allied sciences Experience in raising and maintaining field and glasshouse experiments and recording observations Knowledge of plant pathology and disease screening Working knowledge of computers, data handling and basic statistical analysis

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates not meeting the essential qualifications will not be interviewed A candidate whose relative is an ICAR/IARI employee, found on the interview date, will not be allowed to appear in the interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary, contractual for one year Extendable for two more years, one year at a time, subject to requirement and satisfactory performance Maximum engagement three years (1+1+1) Post is co-terminus with the project; no claim to regular appointment

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates meeting essential qualifications Verification of original certificates/documents Walk-in interview Walk-in interview for shortlisted candidates after verification of original certificates/documents

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form as per Annexure I with attested passport size photograph Scanned certificates from matriculation onwards Date of birth certificate Degree certificate, original or provisional Proof of experience and category proof No objection certificate from present employer

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form in the format annexed (Annexure I) with an attested passport size photograph. Attach scanned certificates from matriculation onwards, date of birth certificate, degree certificate (original or provisional) and recent photograph. Attach proof of experience and self-attested copies of supporting documents. Merge everything into one PDF file. Email it to [email protected] so that it reaches by 15.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA or any other expenses paid for attending the interview Original documents and medical certificate required at the time of joining Concealing of facts or canvassing leads to disqualification or termination

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional -I (YP-1).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 15 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years; minimum 21 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, Women 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30,000 per month consolidated (fixed).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate degree in Agriculture and allied subjects, or a Diploma in relevant Agricultural Sciences (as per ICAR memorandum F. No. Agri. Edn. 1-06/2020-A&P dated 04.12.2020).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with a near or distant relative employed in ICAR/IARI must declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not meeting the essential qualifications will not be interviewed. A candidate whose relative is an ICAR/IARI employee, found on the interview date, will not be allowed to appear in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates meeting essential qualifications. Verification of original certificates/documents. Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview for shortlisted candidates after verification of original certificates/documents.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary, contractual for one year. Extendable for two more years, one year at a time, subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Maximum engagement three years (1+1+1).
